clauses.title: The CLI declares workspace_cleanup_created and its input
The cleanup request is composed inside the package
The autofix driver runs the terminal cleanup through workspace_cleanup_created
requires: const c = run.op('workspace_cleanup_created', { created: s.created }, { allowFail: true });

clauses.title: CL-D84 records the packaged terminal cleanup and its limits
clauses.section: ## CL-D84 — The terminal cleanup is one packaged operation
requires: `workspace_cleanup_created` takes `created`, the data of `workspace_create`, and nothing else
Accepting another input, performing the cleanup anywhere but the repository the receipt states, or continuing a run past a refused cleanup requires a new owner decision

clauses.title: The packaged terminal cleanup is pinned by its own regression
requires: Issue #161 the packaged terminal cleanup removes the workspace from the receipt alone
Issue #161 the parent supplies the created workspace and nothing else
Issue #161 a workspace it must not remove is refused, with the boundary it belongs to
Issue #161 the CLI table, the driver and the record name the packaged terminal cleanup
